description: Île du Diable (Devil's Island) seen across the channel from Île Royale — the only view visitors get, since landing is not possible
verification_note: Île du Diable across the channel — a low, entirely palm-covered island ringed by surf and black rock — seen over the tops of two coconut palms from high on Île Royale. This distant view is all a visitor ever gets; landing is not permitted.
